ios.name: Jevit: AI Judge for Chats
ios.subtitle: Get your texts judged by AI
ios.promotionalText: Is he cheating? Am I wrong? Is she into me? Upload a chat, ask a question, and get the answer in seconds.
ios.reviewNotes: Demo account (no social login needed): on the sign-in screen tap 'Reviewer or tester? Sign in with email' and use the demo credentials provided in the review form. Sign in with Apple also works. Then tap 'Judge a chat', add a screenshot or paste a chat (example: 'Me: you said 7pm / Him: stop nagging me'), ask 'Am I wrong here?' and tap JUDGE IT. Answers are computed by Cloudflare Workers AI (Clef model). Uploaded content is not stored. Account deletion: Account → Delete account.

android.title: Jevit: AI Judge for Chats
android.shortDescription: Upload a chat, ask a question, get an AI answer in seconds.

description:
Who’s right? Ask the AI.

Jevit is an AI judge for your chats. Upload a screenshot of a chat (or paste the messages), ask your question, and get a clear answer in seconds.

ASK ANY QUESTION ABOUT THE CHAT
• Is he cheating?
• Am I wrong here?
• Is she into me?
• Who’s right, me or them?
• How toxic is this?

A CLEAR ANSWER, NOT AN ESSAY
Jevit checks about 20 things in every chat and gives you:
• A big answer: YES, NOPE, YOU WIN, BOTH WRONG…
• How sure it is (it tells you when there isn’t enough to go on)
• The red flags and green flags it found
• Their interest, how toxic it is, and who puts in more effort
• One short piece of advice

SHARE IT
Turn any answer into a card and send it to your friends in one tap.

PRIVATE
Your screenshots are used for one answer and never stored. No ads, no tracking, no selling data. Sign in with Apple or Google so everyone gets free answers every day and bots stay out.

SAFETY FIRST
If a chat shows threats, control, or abuse, Jevit stops joking and points you to real help.

Jevit is for fun. Answers come from AI, can be wrong, and are not psychological, relationship, or legal advice.

Privacy: https://jevit.fun/privacy
Terms: https://jevit.fun/terms
